app.description: Scaffold a new application. --type=flutter supported in Phase 2; angular/ionic/native in later phases.

preset.description: Generate the root workspace skeleton: config files, repo infrastructure (via :infra), AI-assistant instructions (via :llm).

lib.description: Scaffold a shared library under libs/<scope>/<name>: ts, angular, ionic, flutter, assets, styles, state or design-tokens.

env.description: Provision a named environment (e.g. qa, sit, staging) across all workspace apps: env files, project.json configurations, npm scripts.

llm.description: Write a generated description of the workspace (apps, environments, libs, commands, rules) into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md, between nx-polystack markers.

infra.description: Add repo docs (CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY, PR and issue templates), CI gates (GitHub Actions / Jenkins, dependency-cycle check), quality checks (knip, pre-push audit + secretlint) and a scheduled dependency-upgrade workflow. Existing files are kept unless --force.

migrate.description: Bring existing code into the workspace, the source never modified: a standalone Angular CLI or Flutter app as apps/<name>, or the Angular and Flutter projects of an Nx 15-17 workspace at their own paths.

shared-libs.description: Create the shared assets and styles folders and wire them into Angular/Ionic apps.
